description: This file defines a Flutter widget called HomeShell, which serves as the main shell containing bottom navigation tabs for a finance tracking app. It manages navigation among dashboard, transactions, charts, and profile tabs.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main screen with bottom navigation tabs.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class managing the active tab index and rendering the corresponding tab widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HomeShell widget, returning an instance of _HomeShellState.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, rendering a Scaffold with bottom navigation and corresponding tab content.
